title: Death Maze
next_chapter_hook: In the bloody dawn, a brand-new identity quietly took shape outside the imperial city. Chen Ji gazed at the massive city in the distance—where his father and sister were. He had already set an intricate trap, waiting to personally tear apart the net of fate.

text.content:
Amid the torrential blood rain, Chen Ji lay amidst the wreckage, the pierced wound in his chest still gushing blood, staining the blue stone beneath him a shocking dark red. His eyes were tightly shut, his face ashen white as paper, his breathing faint and feeble, as if he might cease at any moment. Only that still faintly beating heart proved he was not truly dead.

Han Lie withdrew his fist covered in blood-colored patterns, haughtily gazing down at the 'corpse' beneath him, a disdainful curve forming at the corner of his mouth. He slowly turned around, addressing the Tianqing Sect disciples who had arrived behind him: 'Atrash is still atrash. Even with some schemes, before absolute strength, it's nothing but a joke! Chen Ji is dead—everyone saw it clearly!'

His voice echoed through the rain, carrying an unrestrained arrogance. The crowd erupted in commotion, some gasping, some lamenting, and others secretly relieved.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie stood with hands clasped behind his back, rainwater sliding down his robust figure, yet unable to extinguish the fierce battle intent in his eyes) Thistrash actually has some spine, taking three of my punches before falling. Hmph, a successor of the Tianji Record? Is this all he's capable of?

text.content:
Han Lie threw his head back in laughter, the sound especially manic amidst the blood rain. He couldn't be bothered to examine the corpse, having absolute confidence in his own strength—that punch had pierced the heart, not even an immortal could save him. He raised his right fist, still stained with Chen Ji's blood, casually wiping it on his robe as if merely crushing an ant.

The surrounding disciples dared not make a sound, none daring to provoke this first genius of the Xuanwu Sect at this moment. Han Lie savored the reverent gazes of the crowd, a satisfaction unlike any he'd felt before surging in his heart. Finally, before the watching masses, he had trampled thattrash who had time and again made him lose face beneath his feet.

Though this 'trampling beneath feet' process was somewhat different from what he had imagined—the other party had never shown a trace of fear even unto death, instead wearing a faint, mocking smile at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: Han Lie took out a jet-black token from his bosom, on which was carved an upright giant eye—the mark of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. He knelt on one knee, raising the token above his head: 'Reporting to my master, your subordinate has fulfilled his duty. Chen Ji, the holder of the Tianji Record, has been executed!'

text.content:
Upon the token, that jet-black vertical eye suddenly glowed with a ghostly green light. A vast and cold will poured forth from the token, enveloping the entire ruins. That will carried no emotion whatsoever, yet weighed like mountains, causing everyone present to involuntarily lower their heads, even a genius like Han Lie feeling a suffocating pressure.

'Chen Ji is dead, the heavenly fate backlash has ended. Very good.' The voice rang directly in everyone's minds. 'Han Lie, you have done well. Come to the imperial city in three days to receive your reward. This one will personally open the higher inheritance of your Xuanwu bloodline for you.'

The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao came quickly and left just as fast. When the voice fell, that suffocating pressure receded like an ebbing tide, leaving only the faintly flickering ghostly light on the token.

dialogue.content: (That will was cold and mechanical, as if merely stating an already predetermined fact) Chen Ji's heavenly fate is exhausted. From this day forth, all fate curses targeting him are lifted. His karmic causes from life will be concluded by this one personally.

text.content:
The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao passed like a cold wind, yet carried away no scent of blood in the rain. No one knew that in the depths of that 'corpse's' mind, a weak yet resolute consciousness was coldly smiling.

Chen Ji's divine sense was like a wisp of silk, coiled around his heart, maintaining that final spark of life. He could perceive everything around him—Han Lie's arrogance, the crowd's exclamations, and that lofty will's declaration.

Excellent. Everything was proceeding according to plan.

He silently calculated the time in his heart. The consumption of his Heavenly Fate Value made his head ache unbearably, but compared to being completely locked onto by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, what was this price? The death curse lifted, the aura of the Tianji Record completely erased... Now, he could finally step outside the chessboard and rearrange the pieces.

In the shadows of the ruins, a withered figure stood watching from afar.

Ling Yuan's eyes slightly narrowed as he stared at that motionless figure in the blood pool, a complex light flickering in his turbid eyes.

As a former candidate for the Tianji Record, he was all too familiar with that aura. But the Chen Ji lying on the ground now had almost completely severed his physical vitality, yet that 'fate' that had brushed past him in the obscure realm had not truly dissipated.

'Interesting.' Ling Yuan murmured softly, his withered fingers lightly掐动 in his sleeve, as if calculating something. 'This little fellow... is more daring than this old man imagined.'

He had no intention of exposing the truth. On the contrary, there was a hidden anticipation in his heart—just how far could this youth who could deceive the Eye of Heavenly Dao go?

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan stroked his flowery white beard, a meaningful smile appearing on his withered face) To rise from the dead—this move... rather has a hint of this old man's style in his younger days. Regrettable. Had you been born a hundred years earlier, perhaps this old man could have taken you as a nominal disciple.

text.content:
In a secluded courtyard in the western suburbs of the imperial city.

Ye Qing abruptly stood up from her meditation cushion, the tea cup in her hand falling and shattering on the ground. Before her, a jade slip transmitting information was emanating a faint glow—it was Chen Ji's unique encryption method.

'Feigned death successful. Eye of Heavenly Dao confirmed. Layout in the imperial city in three days—await my signal then.'

Just a few short lines, yet they made this Holy Sect saint's hands tremble slightly. She took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down, then placed the jade slip in her sleeve and began walking quickly toward the door.

'Summon someone!' Her voice returned to its usual coldness. 'Inform the shadow guards to activate the 'Netherworld Guidance' plan. Activate all hidden pawns in the imperial city—I want to know every guard rotation of the imperial prison!'

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's eyes flickered with complex light, carrying relief and joy alongside a heavy weight for future prospects) Chen Ji, Chen Ji, you truly didn't disappoint me. However... with your 'death,' the entire world is about to fall into chaos.

text.content:
Meanwhile, in the bamboo grove hut at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Su Qingyao sat alone before the window, the sword tassel in her hand unconsciously tightening and loosening. Outside the window, the night was as dark as ink, the rain pouring down heavily, each thunderclap striking her heart like a hammer.

She had already received the news—Chen Ji was dead. Publicly killed by Han Lie, with no remains left.

Those three words were like three daggers, directly cutting out her heart. She didn't believe it. She frantically told herself not to believe it—how could that man as cunning as a fox, whose calculations never missed, die so easily?

But the entire sect was talking about it, everyone had witnessed it with their own eyes. Han Lie's fist had pierced his chest, blood dyeing half the sky red...

'Chen Ji...' she softly called out, her voice hoarse and barely recognizable. A clear tear slid from the corner of her eye, falling onto the cold sword hilt, scattering into tiny droplets.

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's eye sockets were already swollen and red from crying, her once coldly beautiful features now haggard and worn) You scoundrel... you calculated everything... why... why wouldn't you let me help you just once...

text.content:
In the middle of the night, the rain gradually subsided.

A nearly transparent figure quietly landed outside the bamboo grove. Chen Ji forced his broken body to move, each step feeling like walking on knife blades. The massive consumption of his Heavenly Fate Value had his divine sense on the brink of collapse, but there were some things he had to do himself.

Through the gaps in the bamboo window, he saw that usually cold and proud woman, now curled up by the window, her shoulders trembling slightly. His heart clenched—he had never seen her so vulnerable.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, bending his fingers to lightly tap the window frame, three long and two short—that was the secret code between them known to no one else.

Su Qingyao abruptly looked up, an incredulous light flashing in her eyes. She nearly scrambled to the window and pushed it open—

Under the moonlight, the person who should have been dead was staring at her with a pale face, weak yet carrying a hint of a smile.

'You—' She covered her mouth, tears instantly bursting forth like a flood.

'Don't cry.' Chen Ji's voice was hoarse yet gentle. He raised his hand, wanting to wipe away the tears on her face, yet found he barely had the strength to lift his hand. 'I'm fine. It's just... I need you to help me with something.'

Su Qingyao nodded frantically, unable to speak any words, only tightly gripping his hand—that hand was cold as iron, yet made her feel more real than ever.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji weakly leaned against the window frame, rainwater dripping from his hair. He looked at Su Qingyao's tear-streaked face and made the decision for the next move—

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao the entire feigned death plan, making her a knowing participant and jointly involved in the subsequent layout.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the plan, increasing the risk of leakage
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's full support and cooperation
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao's emotions become uncontrolled, others may notice something abnormal

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao bit her lower lip tightly, looking at him through tear-filled eyes, yet slowly nodded after hearing his plan) You madman... fine, I'll help you. From now on, your game is my game.

text.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath, wiped away her tears, and her eyes reignited with the sharp brilliance befitting an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. She helped Chen Ji sit steady and began rapidly analyzing the situation: 'Han Lie is going to the imperial city in three days to receive his reward—this is our biggest opportunity. But before that, you need a brand-new identity...'

She drew a jade token from her sleeve, on which an ancient rune was inscribed: 'This is a Face-Shifting Talisman I obtained during my travels in earlier years. It can last at most seven days. That should be enough to get you through the most dangerous period.'

Chen Ji took the jade token, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Senior Sister Su, you always manage to surprise me at the most critical moments.'

Su Qingyao shot him a glare, yet did not release the hand supporting him: 'Enough of your nonsense. Now, tell me what you plan to do next.'

result_nodes.text: Only reveal part of the plan
result_nodes.description: Only tell Su Qingyao that he is not dead, letting her cooperate with the act without revealing the true purpose and layout.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may expose weaknesses due to not knowing the full picture
result_nodes.visible_reward: Preserve core secrets to reduce the risk of leakage
result_nodes.risk_hint: Information asymmetry may lead to coordination errors at critical moments

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao stares at him blankly, the tears in her eyes not yet dried) Do you still treat me as an outsider?

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then shook his head gently: 'It's not about treating you as an outsider. It's that some things, the less you know, the safer you are.' His tone was calm, yet carried undeniable resolve.

Su Qingyao's lips trembled slightly, as if she wanted to protest something, but ultimately it only turned into a soft sigh: 'Fine. Whatever you say, I'll do it. But you have to promise me one thing—'

She raised her hand, gently pressing it against the unhealed wound on Chen Ji's chest: 'Don't ever make me think you're dead again.'

The touch carried a faint tremor, yet was exceptionally firm. Chen Ji met her gaze and slowly nodded.

result_nodes.text: Request her assistance in the rescue
result_nodes.description: Tell Su Qingyao that he needs to rescue his father and sister, asking her to provide help using her status as Inner Disciple Senior Fellow.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Exposing the biggest weakness, may be exploited
result_nodes.visible_reward: Obtain Inner Sect resource support, greatly increasing the success rate of the rescue
result_nodes.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is still observing in the shadows; Inner Sect actions may attract attention

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao's gaze suddenly turned sharp) Chen Nian? Your sister is still alive?

text.content:
Chen Ji nodded, his voice extremely low: 'She was taken by people from the Holy Sect three months ago. Father is also imprisoned in the imperial capital's prison. I staged my death to have a chance to infiltrate the imperial capital and rescue them.'

Su Qingyao inhaled sharply. Now she finally understood why Chen Ji had to take such a huge risk—that seemingly cold and ruthless man actually carried such profound burdens in his heart.

'The imperial capital's prison is heavily guarded, especially now that Han Lie has made a great contribution, making the security even tighter.' She frowned in contemplation, 'But... if I go to the imperial capital under the pretext of paying respects to the deceased, I might be able to gain some convenience.'

result_nodes.description: Ask Su Qingyao to secretly investigate Ling Yuan's movements and test whether the old Sect Master has discovered the truth of the staged death.
result_nodes.visible_cost: May alert the snake and arouse Ling Yuan's vigilance
result_nodes.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on Ling Yuan and preemptively avoid risks
result_nodes.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may expose her investigation intentions and bring trouble upon herself

dialogue.content: (Su Qingyao furrowed her brows slightly, lost in thought) Are you saying... the Patriarch Master might know something?

text.content:
Chen Ji leaned against the wall, panting as he said: 'When I lay in a pool of blood today, I sensed a faint spiritual consciousness. That direction... was precisely where the Patriarch is located. He didn't expose me, either because he truly didn't notice, or because he has other motives.'

Su Qingyao's expression grew solemn: 'Ancestor Ling Yuan... that is a being even the Sect Elders must look up to. If he truly察觉了什么—'

'That's why I need you to test him.' Chen Ji grasped her hand, 'No need to alert the snake, just observe his reactions during daily contact. If he truly knows something... we must prepare countermeasures in advance.'

Su Qingyao nodded seriously: 'Rest assured, I won't let you down.'

Meanwhile, deep within the imperial palace of the royal capital.

The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao condensed an illusory eye in the Void. That colossal eye swept across heaven and earth, its pupil reflecting Han Lie's ecstatic face, then turned toward the Tianqing Sect—where Chen Ji's 'corpse' was being hastily collected.

'The Tianji Record holder has been eliminated. The threads of fate have been gathered.' The will murmured to itself, its voice betraying not a trace of emotion, 'Now, simply wait for the next chess piece to awaken...'

It did not notice that within the deepest part of that 'corpse's' heart, a wisp of nearly imperceptible purple light was slowly pulsing. That was the fragment of the Tianji Record, having automatically entered a dormant state when its master was at death's door—and dormancy is the best disguise.

dialogue.content: (The colossal eye slowly closed, as if having completed its mission) Ridiculous humans, always thinking they can escape fate's arrangement. Hmph... Chen Ji, you are merely a discarded piece in my long chess game.

text.content:
Within the Tianji Record's sealed space, a withered figure sat cross-legged.

Mo Xiansheng—the soul guardian left by Chen Xuan—slowly opened his eyes, a flicker of relief passing through his turbid gaze.

'This kid... is actually more resolute than this old man imagined.' He murmured, 'Facing death to survive, cutting off an arm to preserve the whole... Chen Xuan's choice of him back then was indeed not mistaken.'

He lowered his head to look at the yellowed ancient page in his hands—that was the second page of the Tianji Record, the newly unsealed ability that finally awakened after Chen Ji completed his staged death scheme.

'Come then, let this old man see... what else you need.' His withered fingers gently brushed across the page, line after line of ancient characters manifesting in the air, revealing the brand-new fortune awaiting Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: After bidding farewell to Su Qingyao, Chen Ji felt a strange disturbance within the Tianji Record. He immersed his consciousness into the sealed space, only to discover that Mo Xiansheng was showing him newly unsealed abilities—

choices.description: Unseal the second page's ability, allowing one to briefly interfere with others' perception of oneself, making the feigning-death Chen Ji even harder to detect.
choices.risk_hint: Will emit faint spiritual energy fluctuations during use, possibly detectable by experts

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng stroked his beard and smiled, though his eyes carried a solemn weight) The Tianji Mist Eye can veil the perception of all living beings within a ten-zhang radius. But boy, this technique consumes greatly—with your current condition, you can use it at most once per day.

text.content:
Chen Ji sensed the profound technique newly embedded in his mind, his lips curling slightly. An invisibility ability—precisely what he needed right now. With this, even if encountered a search in the imperial city, he would have an additional trump card to save his life.

Mo Xiansheng added: "However, you must remember, this mist eye can only conceal perception, not aura. Should you encounter an old monster of Ling Yuan's caliber, you must still run."

"Thank you for the reminder, sir." Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his consciousness gradually returning to reality.

choices.description: Unseal the second page's ability, allowing one to reverse three breaths of time at a crucial moment, granting Chen Ji an opportunity to counterattack or escape.
choices.risk_hint: Will fall into brief weakness after reversal, use with caution

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng squinted his eyes, his tone carrying a warning) Heavenly Fate Reversal... this technique can well be called defying heaven. But boy, your life was originally snatched from fate's hands—snatching it once more, what's the harm?

text.content:
Chen Ji felt as if his mind was suddenly and violently expanding, with countless profound symbols flowing through his consciousness. It was an extraordinary sensation—like time in his perception had been fractured into countless fragments, and he only needed to, at a crucial moment, pick up one of those pieces and reassemble it.

Three breaths. Merely three breaths.

But for a person whose calculations never missed, three breaths were sufficient to alter everything.

Mo Xiansheng's form started to blur: "Remember, boy, the stronger the ability, the greater the cost. Heavenly Fate points are the bridge connecting you to the Tianji Record—when they are completely exhausted, that is the moment of your true death."

As his words fell, Chen Ji's consciousness was forcibly ejected from the sealed space.

choices.description: Obtain a Fragment of Fate documenting clues about his father's whereabouts, revealing his father is imprisoned in the seventh level of the Imperial City Prison.
choices.risk_hint: The fragment's information may be incomplete, requiring further verification

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's withered finger pointed on a page of yellowed paper) This is the clue I found for you—your father Chen Yuan is in the deepest part of the Imperial City Prison. But... there is still a layer of seal on this page, which requires you to unseal yourself.

text.content:
Chen Ji's breath turned sudden and rapid. It was the first time he had lost composure before Mo Xiansheng.

Father... he is still alive.

The information on the fragment was extremely vague, only showing a general location—the seventh level of the Imperial City Prison—and a time node—three days later.

"Three days later is precisely the day Han Lie goes to the Imperial City to receive his reward." Chen Ji murmured, his mind racing, "By then, everyone's attention will be diverted..."

This was a perfect opportunity. And he would never let it slip.

choices.text: Inquire about the truth of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Seizing the opportunity to interact with Mo Xiansheng, persistently question about the ultimate secrets of the Heavenly Eye and the origin of the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Mo Xiansheng, leading to relationship deterioration
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might refuse to answer, or even revoke some abilities

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's eyes narrowed slightly, his aged voice carrying a hint of displeasure) You boy, quite greedy indeed. Some things, when the time hasn't come, asking is pointless.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not back down: 'Sir, I have already been marked by the Heavenly Eye. If I don't even know what my enemy is, how can I possibly respond?'

Mo Xiansheng fell into a long silence before sighing: 'Very well, it wouldn't hurt to tell you something. The Tianji Record... is not of this world. It comes from a higher dimension, and the Heavenly Eye is the will-projection of that dimension cast upon this realm.'

Chen Ji's heart jolted.

'As for more... wait until you truly touch the essence of destiny.' Mo Xiansheng's form began to fade, 'Remember, the Tianji Record is merely a tool. The true master is yourself. Don't lose sight of what truly matters.'

Chen Ji's consciousness exited the sealed space, and dawn was already breaking outside the window.

Su Qingyao had left at some point, leaving only a bowl of still steaming medicinal soup and a note: 'I am going to prepare for the matters in three days. Rest well, and don't push yourself.'

The handwriting was elegant, yet carried an undeniable determination.

Chen Ji drained the bowl in one gulp. The bitter liquid slid down his throat into his stomach, transforming into a warm force that barely stabilized his precarious vitality. He leaned against the wall, resting with closed eyes, while his mind raced.

Three days.

In three days, Han Lie would go to the imperial capital to receive his reward, drawing the attention of all高手. That would be his best opportunity to infiltrate the imperial prison.

And before that, he needed to do three things—heal his wounds, change his identity, and... contact Ye Qing.

The morning light pierced through the clouds, illuminating a remote path outside the imperial capital.

A middle-aged man in coarse cloth clothing, with a scar across his face, walked slowly with a carrying pole. His steps were steady, but his eyes revealed a sharpness that didn't match his appearance.

This man was Chen Ji.

The disguise talisman worked surprisingly well, changing not only his features but completely concealing his aura. He now looked like an ordinary goods peddler. No one would connect him with the 'dead'trash disciple of the Tianqing Sect.

In the distance, the majestic walls of the imperial capital were already faintly visible.

Chen Ji stopped, gazing at that massive structure, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips.

Father, little sister... wait for me.

In this life, I will never let anyone harm you again.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji gently touched the Jade Pendant bearing Ye Qing's mark in his sleeve, a tender light flickering in his eyes) Ye Qing... this cooperation, Chen Ji will remember. The favor I owe you, I will repay in the future.

text.content:
Meanwhile, in a tea room private booth in the eastern market of the imperial capital.

Ye Qing, in a crimson dress, was leisurely sipping fragrant tea. Across from her sat a handsome scholar—one of the contact persons arranged by Ye Qing, a secret agent of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path embedded in the imperial capital.

'Chen Ji is dead?' The scholar frowned. 'This news is spreading everywhere, but why would the Saintess动用 such a top-tier secret agent as 'Psychic Guidance'? Could there be a trap?'

Ye Qing set down her teacup, a meaningful smile curving at her lips: 'A trap? No no no... this man is far more terrifying than you imagine.'

She raised her head, gazing toward the direction of the imperial capital outside the window, her eyes flickering with complex brilliance.

'The person I've been waiting for will arrive soon.'

choice.prompt: After Chen Ji infiltrated the imperial capital, the first choice he faced was—

choices.text: Rush directly to the prison to save his father
choices.description: Time is short, infiltrate the imperial prison directly and rescue his father during the guard rotation.
choices.visible_cost: Injuries not yet healed, combat power greatly reduced
choices.visible_reward: Act first to avoid any mishap befalling his father
choices.risk_hint: Deep penetration alone, if discovered will fall into a desperate situation

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji lowered his hat, blending into the flow of people near the prison) Can't wait any longer. Every moment more, father is in greater danger.

text.content:
Outside the imperial prison, Chen Ji hid in a dark alley. He observed the formidable building nearby, calculating silently in his heart.

The main gate had more than ten guards, each a Foundation Building cultivator or above. More troublesome was the warning formation at the entrance—any unauthorized intrusion would trigger the alarm.

But all of this was within Chen Ji's expectations.

He took out a pitch-black token from his sleeve—the demonic path pass delivered by Ye Qing's people. Through the delicate relationship between the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path and the imperial family, this token was enough to grant him free passage in specific areas.

Of course, only 'specific areas.' The seventh level... would have to depend on himself.

choices.text: First meet with Ye Qing for coordination
choices.description: Go to the tea house to meet Ye Qing as planned, obtain more detailed intelligence and the prison layout before acting.
choices.visible_cost: Waste half a day, miss the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence and insider support, greatly reduce risk
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have other motives, cooperation requires caution

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing set down her teacup, looking at the scarred man appearing at the door, her lips slightly raised) You came faster than I expected. I thought you would rest a few more days.

text.content:
Chen Ji entered the booth guided by the scholar and closed the door behind him.

Ye Qing打量着他，眼中闪过一丝surprised：'易容符的效果不错，连我都差点没认出来。看来你为了这一天，准备了很久。'

'魔道圣宗的接应点，皇城大牢的布防图，还有三日后韩烈领赏时的守卫轮换……' Chen Ji在Ye Qing对面坐下，一字一顿道，'这些，你应该都准备好了吧？'

Ye Qing轻笑一声，从袖中取出一卷羊皮纸：'都在这里了。你那位老子的位置，我也打探清楚了——第七层，天字号牢房，由三名结丹期高手轮守。'

她顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝grave：'不过，有件事你必须知道——你妹妹陈念，并不在大牢里。'

choices.description: Don't rush into action, but hide and observe Han Lie and his group's movements, seeking more exploitable intelligence.
choices.visible_reward: Gather intelligence on Han Lie's whereabouts and weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's informants

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji lowered his voice, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes) Han Lie... let me see what other cards you have up your sleeve.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act hastily. He knew that someone like Han Lie would surely have numerous informants around him. Rather than rushing into battle, it would be better to first assess the enemy's strengths and weaknesses.

He changed into a different set of clothes and blended into the crowd outside the west gate of the imperial capital. This was the必经之路 for Han Lie's group entering the city.

True enough, before half an hour had passed, a commotion came from the distance.

Han Lie rode a beast of entirely crimson coloration, followed by more than a dozen experts from the Xuanwu Sect, advancing aggressively toward the city gate. Commoners along the route hastily stepped aside, murmuring among themselves.

"I heard it's the Young Sect Master of the Xuanwu Sect, here to receive a reward for his great achievements!"

"Tsk tsk, now that's what you call a limitless future..."

Chen Ji mingled among the crowd, a derisive arc curving at the corner of his lips. Limitless future? We'll see how far this "limitless future" fellow can jump.

choices.description: Since my sister is not in the prison, I should focus on investigating Chen Nian's whereabouts first, as this concerns the core of the entire rescue plan.
choices.visible_cost: Spreading attention thin, may end up neglecting one thing while losing another
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence on Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The investigation may alert the Holy Sect, startling the snake

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly, though he极力保持calm) Not in the prison... then where is my sister?

text.content:
Ye Qing's expression grew grave: "According to my intelligence, Chen Nian was taken to the 'Altar of Heaven' in the northern outskirts of the imperial capital. That is a sacrificial site for the Eyes of Heavenly Dao in the mortal realm, specifically used for some kind of... ritual."

"Ritual?" Chen Ji's eyes narrowed dangerously.

"I'm not sure of the specifics either." Ye Qing shook his head, "I only know that the Holy Sect sends people there at regular intervals, most of them children with special physiques. Your sister has been called the 'Heavenly Fate Key,' she probably has something to do with the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's plans."

Chen Ji's fist slowly tightened within his sleeve.

Special physique? Heavenly Fate Key?

Hesneeredin his heart—whatever key you are, if you dare touch my sister, you will pay the price.

Night hung like ink, the Altar of Heaven in the northern outskirts of the imperial capital stood beneath the moonlight, appearing especially gloomy.

Chen Ji concealed himself behind an ancient tree, gazing at that mysterious structure from afar. The perimeter of the Altar of Heaven was filled with formations—even with his current spiritual sense strength, he dared not approach recklessly.

But his eyes caught a familiar figure—

It was a young woman in white robes, bound in chains, being escorted into the depths of the Altar of Heaven by two figures in black.

Chen Nian.

That was his sister, the person he cared most about in this world.

Even from such a great distance, he could clearly see the stubborn expression on his sister's face—even in captivity, she showed no signs of surrender.

"Wait for me." Chen Ji silently念叨, his voice low yet resolute, "Brother will definitely come to save you."

His figure merged into the night, like a leopard poised to spring.

Three days later, the imperial capital would surely be swept by a血雨腥风.

Meanwhile, at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain.

Su Qingyao stood outside the Sect Leader's grand hall, took a deep breath, and walked in slowly.

Ling Yuan sat in meditation at the hall's center, eyes slightly closed, surrounded by faint spiritual energy. Hearing her footsteps, he slowly opened his eyes, the turbid depths flickering with a profound light.

"Qingyao, you've come." His voice wascalm如水, "I presume you've come regarding Chen Ji's matter?"

Su Qingyao's heart jolted violently, yet she forced herself to remain composed, bowing respectfully: "This disciple indeed comes regarding Brother Chen Ji. He... is after all a disciple of our Tianqing Sect, now meeting such a tragic end. This disciple wishes to arrange his funeral affairs."

Ling Yuan remained silent for a moment, then suddenly smiled.

That smile sent a chill down Su Qingyao's spine.

"Funeral affairs?" Ling Yuan rose slowly, his withered figure appearing especially sinister in the candlelight, "Qingyao, do you truly believe... that Chen Ji is dead?"

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan paced toward Su Qingyao, each step seeming to tread upon her heart) This old man has lived for several hundred years, what storms haven't I weathered? A mere fake death technique, did you think it could escape my eyes? However...

text.content:
Ling Yuan's words stopped abruptly, the atmosphere within the hall instantly freezing.

Su Qingyao's hand had already secretly gripped her sword hilt, her knuckles turning white. She knew that if Ling Yuan were to expose everything at this moment, both she and Chen Ji would fall into an abyss from which there was no return.

However, Ling Yuan merely smiled, turning back toward his meditation cushion.

"However, that boy managed to deceive the Eyes of Heavenly Dao—he does have some ability." He closed his eyes again, "Go ahead. Chen Ji's funeral affairs... arrange them as you said."

Su Qingyao stared at that withered back in disbelief, momentarily unsure how to react.

What did Ling Yuan mean? He clearly knew the truth, yet chose to stand by and watch?

With a belly full of doubts, she retreated from the hall.

What she did not know was that after she left, Ling Yuan opened his eyes, the turbid depths flickering with a dangerous gleam.

"Chen Ji... this old man would like to see how far you can go."

Three days later, the imperial capital.

Han Lie's convoy rolled grandly into the imperial palace, drawing countless commoners to watch and envy. No one noticed that among the crowd, an ordinary-looking middle-aged man was quietly observing all this.

Chen Ji lowered his bamboo hat, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips.

Han Lie, Han Lie, you think you're here to receive a reward? Little do you know, every step you take is adding bricks to my plan.

He turned and walked toward the direction of the imperial prison.

Tonight, he would personally tear open the net of fate, reclaim everything that belonged to him—

Father, sister, and the truth that had been toyed with by heaven.

The night of the imperial capital was destined not to be peaceful.

And he, Chen Ji, was about to ignite his own fire within this darkness.
